# DESIGN.md — <BUSINESS NAME>

**Regenerate this file every time a section is added.** It goes stale immediately and a stale
design doc is how a later pass undoes a deliberate decision.

Last regenerated: <YYYY-MM-DD> · Against: <commit sha>

## Direction thesis

One paragraph: what this place actually is, and the world that follows from it. The direction
contract at the top of `<body>` on the home page carries the short version; this is the long
one. If they disagree, fix one.

## Palette

Ground the accent in something real about the business — not a palette generator, and not the
AI-default warm cream + serif display + terracotta. If the ground and display face already
match half of that combination, put the accent somewhere else entirely.

| Token | Value | Role | Grounded in |
|-------|-------|------|-------------|
| `--ink` | | body text | |
| `--ground` | | page background | |
| `--accent` | | | |

## Documented scale steps

Every spacing and size value on the site is one of these. When a new value is flagged by the
checks, first ask whether an existing step covers the same role — mapping a one-off onto an
existing step tightens the ramp; adding an exception loosens it.
